messages:
sam: Quick flag: cost dashboard shows negative cache savings for t-510 after last canary :confused:
tess: saw that in the morning. looks like duplicate prefetch credits from a backfill run
arjun: quick repro: tenant t-510, window 2026-03-21T02:00..2026-03-21T06:00, batch=backfill-20260321
mei: backend note: rollup currently groups credits by credit_type only, so "prefetch" + "prefetch:backfill" both sum
sam: short-term mitigation idea: dedupe by (origin_id, request_sig, credit_hash) for events within 24h
tess: careful: some flows legitimately get multiple credits. propose precedence rules: backfill < prefetch < rebate and surface the chosen reason in UI
arjun: UI ask: add a compact explain-row when net < 0 listing top 5 credit contributors + an optional counterfactual toggle to remove prefetch credits
mei: API sketch: GET /internal/v1/cost-preview?tenant=t-510&window=4h&detail=provenance&counterfactual=prefetch -> { numeric fields, provenance: [top contributors], counterfactual_net }
sam: provenance should be opt-in (?detail=provenance) and capped (top 5 + "others") to avoid large payloads
arjun: sampling caveat: some tenants are 10% sampled for econ panels. counterfactual extrapolation must use sampling_version header so clients can reconcile
ops-bot: CI: billing-rollup backfill-20260321 ran at 03:12 UTC (status: success) https://ci.internal/reports/7102
tess: plan: hotfix rollup dedupe today (arjun), add debug dump, enable cost-preview v0.2 on canary for 1h, validate t-510 and t-333
sam: draft support blurb: "We observed duplicate prefetch credits caused by a backfill; displayed cache-saving metrics were affected, billing unaffected. Fix deployed." 
mei: opening PR for rollup dedupe and precedence rules, marking urgent
arjun: will add sampling_version header and counterfactual support in cost-preview API
sam: post-fix check: if canary shows positives for t-510 I'll schedule prod rollout. thanks :thumbsup:
